The official site's per-item 2D GIF download action constructs the fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/latest/{rgi}/512.gif URL. A metadata-only HEAD request to this candidate returned 200, image/gif, Content-Length 1388932 and Last-Modified Wed, 16 Sep 2026 00:01:55 GMT, without a redirect or login.
